items.title: Krull principal and general height theorem via local Artinian stabilization and generator-reduction induction
items.source_title: mathlib4 fixed author library; selected KrullHeight module group
items.difficulty_reason: Actual proof includes localization at a prime, an Artinian descending chain of localized/comapped ideal powers and two Nakayama applications for the principal theorem; the general theorem uses strong induction in the number of generators, radical replacement and prime-cover/minimal-prime reduction. This is not a terminal height/span-rank inequality by applying an already supplied height theorem. Remaining finite-height, parameter-generator, quotient and going-down conclusions are retained in the same author module without splitting their support steps into counts.
